screen.rationale: Primary study; KOH-pretreated PET and PLA microplastics with CQDs@TiO2 under a 250 W Xe lamp (100 mW/cm2, passes E3; the brief KOH surface treatment leaves solid polymer, so E4 is not the failing criterion), but the only quantitative outcome is gravimetric 'degradation rate' (mass loss, Tables 3-4: 29.8% PET, 58.9% PLA at 48 h, pH 8); LC-MS/HS-GC-MS products are identified qualitatively in SI and no molar mass is measured.

excluded_observations.what: Mass-loss degradation rates for PET and PLA, pH 6.8-8.0, with/without alkali and catalyst
excluded_observations.why: Mass loss is not an E5 endpoint.

excluded_observations.what: Degradation intermediates (benzoic acid, MHET, lactic acid, ethanol, acetaldehyde...)
excluded_observations.why: Identified qualitatively; no amounts; details in SI Tables S3-S5.
